CVE-2026-4404 reports that Harbor ships with the well-known default admin password "Harbor12345" when HARBOR_ADMIN_PASSWORD is not set at first boot. The Docker Hardened harbor-core image does not bake a password into the image: HARBOR_ADMIN_PASSWORD must be supplied via environment variable at deployment time (required for the container to start a meaningful admin session), and image/harbor-core/guides.md explicitly calls this out under the Helm and docker compose examples. Deployments that follow the documented configuration never reach the default-password code path.
